caption: Choose two saved Atlas payloads from the vault.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['json-payload-delta']; p.modal?.close(); p.pro.signOut(); p.openCompare(); const m = p.modal; m.oldPath = 'JSON Payload Delta/old.json'; m.newPath = 'JSON Payload Delta/new.json'; m.reset(); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Compare pointer paths, missing fields, and array indices.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['json-payload-delta']; p.modal?.close(); p.pro.signOut(); p.openCompare(); const m = p.modal; m.oldPath = 'JSON Payload Delta/old.json'; m.newPath = 'JSON Payload Delta/new.json'; await m.preview(); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Open the report with links to the saved source files.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['json-payload-delta']; p.modal?.close(); p.pro.signOut(); p.openCompare(); const m = p.modal; m.oldPath = 'JSON Payload Delta/old.json'; m.newPath = 'JSON Payload Delta/new.json'; await m.preview(); const f = await p.createReport(m.comparison); m.close(); await app.workspace.openLinkText(f.path,'',false); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Select a named Atlas payload pair for a repeated comparison.
eval: (async () => { const p = app.plugins.plugins['json-payload-delta']; p.modal?.close(); p.pro.signOut(); p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('json-payload-delta-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); await p.saveProfile({name:'Atlas release payload',oldPath:'JSON Payload Delta/old.json',newPath:'JSON Payload Delta/new.json',ignore:['/generatedAt']}); p.openCompare(); const m = p.modal; m.oldPath = 'JSON Payload Delta/old.json'; m.newPath = 'JSON Payload Delta/new.json'; m.profileName = 'Atlas release payload'; m.draftName = m.profileName; m.draftIgnore = '/generatedAt'; m.reset(); return 'ok'; })()
